B1.text: (Title of book: The Great World-Order, here attributed to Democritus).

B1a.text: (Restoration of Herculanean Papyrus in which Democritus is accused of plagiarising from The Great World-Order' of Leucippus). Certain terms of the Atomic Theory can probably be traced to Leucippus, e.g. Atoms ('uncuttables'). Close-pressed (units). Great Void. Absection. Rhythm (meaning 'form'). Contact (meaning 'arrangement'). Aspect (meaning 'position'). Entanglement. Eddy.

B2.text: (From a treatise 'On Mind'). Nothing happens at random; everything happens out of reason and by necessity.
